title: Simulation configuration
description: Battle clock, resource-flow and unit-movement constants (W1-4, W1-5). In-battle ramp caps and Overload (W1-7). Later issues add fields.

ticksPerSecond.description: Fixed ticks per second of battle time (CB-10).

inputBufferUnits.description: Capacity, in units, of each consumer input buffer.

breachBaseCost.description: Path cost of stepping through a cell covered by an enemy building when a base is sealed (CB-20), before the health term. An open cell costs 1.

breachHealthPerCost.description: Health that adds 1 to the cost of stepping through a building (rounded up): cost = breachBaseCost + ceil(health / breachHealthPerCost).

aggroRangeCells.description: Manhattan range within which a unit that has no enemy in reach chases the nearest enemy unit (CB-16). 0 turns chasing off.

maxSourceSpeedPercent.description: Global cap, in percent, on the summed source_speed bonus of one side (SC-8). The source interval is floor(interval * 100 / (100 + bonus)), at least 1.

maxUnitStrengthPercent.description: Global cap, in percent, on the summed unit_strength bonus of one side (SC-8). A unit spawned under bonus P gets health and damage mulPct(base, 100 + P).

overloadStartTick.description: First battle tick of Overload level 1 (CB-12).

overloadIntervalTicks.description: Ticks between Overload levels; level = 1 + floor((tick - overloadStartTick) / overloadIntervalTicks) once the start tick is reached.

overloadDamageStepPercent.description: Extra unit attack damage per Overload level, in percent: damage = mulPct(damage, 100 + level * step). Turrets are not affected.

overloadCoreDamageStep.description: Core damage per Overload level. On every interval tick both Cores take level * step damage.

maxBattleTicks.description: Hard cap on battle length in ticks (CB-33). A battle that reaches it with both Cores alive is decided by relative Core health. Overload makes this unreachable in normal play.

timelineSampleTicks.description: Ticks between samples of the battle summary timeline.
